title: Historical per-title display framing concerns
symptom: Earlier builds showed inconsistent bars or vertical placement in several PAL/NTSC title screens and clips.
expected: The specification-derived MCD212 aperture, player pixel aspect, screenshots, and pointer mapping agree without title-specific cropping.
revalidation_reason: Reports span several pre-ac20dcd display implementations and screenshots without a consistently recorded commit. Recheck only discrepancies that remain visible on ac20dcd or a later build.
